candidate_pool: 21 complete-sequence policies: baseline, six global boundary shifts, six gradient snaps, six weak-island removals, two combinations; duplicate sequences masked
gate: Finite-pool oracle robust gain averaged equally across four own train matches >=0.01 in BOTH folds before any candidate validation is read/scored. Otherwise stop with no selector fit or validation.
loss: Exact expected 1-official_spellF1 over finite softmax hypotheses; labels enter only training losses, not generation/features/inference
control: Best single policy on mean own train robust objective, stable policy order ties
generalization_limit: Frozen teachers saw their own train matches. Train oracle/ranking losses are optimistic screening; only own validation is held out from all fitted parameters. Both validations previously explored.
